title: feat(status-pages): one-screen builder, live screen and the page as its own editor

summaries.body:
## Maple review 🟢 **Confidence 10/10** · safe to merge Draft create, publishing, the preview endpoint and the builder's submit/error paths are pinned by tests; the later half of `editor.scene.test.ts` and the view-only files I read in part are the residua… no findings · tests covered · risk medium · 3/3 new units observable Adds a one-screen status page builder at `/status-pages/new`, moves status pages out of the Alerts hub, and gives pages a `draft` flag plus a preview endpoint rendering real monitor history. No defects found; the open `McpQueryError` issues in `page/registry.ts` are untouched by this change. - `StatusPagesService.create` takes components and a `draft` flag, publishing only on request - New `POST /v2/status_pages/preview` renders an unsaved page from the org's own uptime history - Pages move to `/status-pages` with a builder at `/status-pages/new`; old Alerts links redirect - The editor becomes canvas plus side panel with autosave, and a separate live screen ### Before merge - [ ] **Env var** · Set `VITE_STATUS_PAGE_BASE_URL` in every environment, or confirm its default · [`apps/web/src/page/status-pages/shared/commands.ts:228`](https://github.com/MapleTechLabs/maple/blob/05b42e4319ac891be56eeaa4f69fe46d43147378/apps/web/src/page/status-pages/shared/commands.ts#L228) - [ ] **Migration** · Check it is safe on production data and with the code still deployed · [`packages/db/drizzle/20261029195537_status_page_draft/migration.sql`](https://github.com/MapleTechLabs/maple/blob/05b42e4319ac891be56eeaa4f69fe46d43147378/packages/db/drizzle/20261029195537_status_page_draft/migration.sql) - [ ] **Infra** · Check every environment has what this config now expects · [`alchemy.run.ts`](https://github.com/MapleTechLabs/maple/blob/05b42e4319ac891be56eeaa4f69fe46d43147378/alchemy.run.ts) ### Production impact

What was checked - The preview only reads monitors the caller's org owns (`ensureMonitorsInOrg` before `readMonitorData`) - Publisher sweep filters `draft` and `publish` returns early on a draft, pinned by `StatusPagePublisher.test.ts` - Old `/alerts/status-pages/*` and `?tab=` links redirect, pinned by `route.test.ts`; preview ids are confined to the editor flag (`render.test.ts`)
Observability coverage: 3 of 3 changes observable | Change | Kind | Observable | Evidence | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | POST /v2/status_pages/preview | inbound HTTP route | yes | v2 routes are auto-instrumented (Maple sees `POST /v2/alerts/rules/preview` siblings); handler work is span-wrapped and errors stay typed | | StatusPageSnapshotBuilder.buildDraft | database work | yes | `Effect.fn("StatusPageSnapshotBuilder.buildDraft")` span over the monitor and history reads | | StatusPagePublisher.publish draft short-circuit | worker | yes | existing publisher span and publish-failed log; the change only adds an early return with `written: false` |
